conversation.text: I need to file a warranty claim. The unit you installed last year stopped working.
To file a claim, call to schedule a warranty diagnostic.
If the failure is covered, there is no diagnostic fee, but if the technician determines it is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies (Warranty Policy, Filing a claim).

A unit installed last year falls within the 2-year labor warranty on full system installations, and Comfort Club members at the time of installation have a 5-year labor warranty (Warranty Policy, New system installation warranty).
Manufacturer parts warranties are separate and vary by brand, and Meridian registers every installed unit with the manufacturer within 30 days of install (Warranty Policy).
To find your account, please give me your full name and one of the following: your account number, service address or phone number.
Sure, it's Grace Garcia, 512-686-4786.
Thanks, Grace.
I have three openings for an HVAC repair visit: Wednesday 21 October from 8:00 to 12:00, Friday 23 October from 12:00 to 16:00, or Saturday 24 October from 8:00 to 12:00.
Which one suits you?
Tomorrow if you can. Is there anything open then?

Nothing is open tomorrow, Saturday 17 October, but I can offer you an HVAC repair visit on Wednesday 21 October from 8:00 to 12:00, Friday 23 October from 12:00 to 16:00, or Saturday 24 October from 8:00 to 12:00.
Which one suits you?

The original line "Take it" likely refers to accepting an offered slot. The earliest is Wednesday, so I'll take that.

Okay, I'll take the Wednesday 21 October morning slot then.
Just to confirm, Grace: an HVAC repair visit on Wednesday 21 October, arriving between 8:00 and 12:00.
Can you give me a clear yes so I go ahead and book it?
Yes, please book it.
Booked: your HVAC repair visit on Wednesday, October 21, 8am to 12pm, with Jun Park.
That's all, thank you so much.
Thanks for contacting Meridian Home Comfort. Have a great day.

conversation.text: Hi, I have two things: my AC is blowing warm air and I want to get someone out, and I'd like to know if joining the maintenance plan would save me money on this.

I've passed this to our team: Ticket #1. Someone will contact you within one business day. So the team can reach you, please tell me your name and your account number, phone number or service address. You can keep asking me other questions here.
Omar Martinez, 2452 Windcrest Ave, Pflugerville.
Thanks, Omar.
Pflugerville is in our service area for ZIP codes 78660 and 78634 (policies/service_area.md), so I'm not able to confirm your ZIP from what you gave me, and your ticket is already with the team.
On whether the plan would save you money on this repair, the facts I have are limited.

The 2026 Residential Fee Schedule (pricing/2026_fee_schedule.pdf) says the member repair discount applies to parts and labor on residential HVAC repairs, and that monthly membership requires a 12-month minimum.
It also says the plumbing discount applies to Plus members only.
The documents I have don't give the discount percentage, the plan's price, or the services the plan includes, so I can't say whether joining would save you money on this repair.
They also don't cover a firm repair total.
If your AC stops working after hours, the FAQ (faq/customer_faq.md) says the 24/7 emergency line covers no-cool calls, with a $149 after-hours dispatch fee in addition to the repair cost.
So it pays for itself basically.
I can't say that it pays for itself, because the facts don't show whether it would on this repair.

Comfort Club members get the seasonal tune-up included, which is otherwise $129 (pricing/repair_price_book_2026.csv), and Comfort Club members get $500 off a system replacement (services/service_catalog.md).

The 2026 Residential Fee Schedule (pricing/2026_fee_schedule.pdf) also says the member repair discount applies to parts and labor on residential HVAC repairs, and that monthly membership requires a 12-month minimum.

The documents don't give the discount percentage or the plan's price, and they don't say whether these benefits apply to a visit booked on the day of joining, so a team member confirms that when setting up the membership.
Yeah, add it and book the visit.
I can offer these HVAC repair slots, all on Monday 19 October 2026: 1) 08:00-12:00, 2) 12:00-16:00, or 3) 13:00-17:00.
Which one suits you?
I've added that to Ticket #1; our team will contact you within one business day.
Book it. The 08:00-12:00 slot on Monday works.
Just to confirm before I go ahead: an HVAC repair visit on Monday 19 October 2026, in the 08:00-12:00 window.
Can you give me a clear yes to book that?
Yes, book it.
Booked: your HVAC repair visit on Monday, October 19, 8am to 12pm, with Marta Kowalski.
Can you hear me okay?
No problem, take your time.
No, that's it. Thanks.
Thanks for contacting Meridian Home Comfort. Have a great day.
